dialogue.text: [warm, storytelling] Level four is a hundred and sixty thousand dollars. The customer is the woman who owns the flower shop on Main Street, and when her name pops up, Gloria does something Jess hasn't seen her do all day. She stands up.
Over a hundred K, you stand.
[warm, storytelling] Real banks do this too. At Chase, about a hundred and fifty thousand dollars makes you a private client. You get your own banker, and you never wait in line.
I got a thirty-five-dollar overdraft fee yesterday. A check went through before I moved money over from savings.
[warm, storytelling] It's the exact same fee Jess got. But before the florist can even finish her sentence, Gloria clicks one button, and the fee is gone in about ten seconds.
I called about mine and got a recording.
You asked a machine. She didn't even have to ask.
